items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Well, they used to call him "Posey" in the Duke Ellington Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. But that didn't stop him. Them fingers didn't stop him. And he could blow the trumpet, too. He could blow. And he'd twirl that trumpet around! Heh-heh! Oh, he was something. And he'd smoke a great big cigar. Yeah, Freddy Jenkins was something. Well, they used to call him "Posey" in the Duke Ellington Band.
